The angle condition gives
\[
\frac{O-C}{T}\cdot 360^\circ = 9^\circ \implies O-C = \frac{T}{40}.
\]
Using \(O=0.3T+3\) and \(C=0.35T-6\),
\[
O-C = (0.3T+3)-(0.35T-6)=9-0.05T.
\]
So
\[
9-0.05T=\frac{T}{40}.
\]
Since \(0.05T=\frac{T}{20}\),
\[
9=\frac{T}{40}+\frac{T}{20}=\frac{3T}{40},
\]
hence
\[
T=120.
\]

\[
\boxed{120}
\]
